issue.title: record-walk e2e startup opens a file before any workspace leaf exists
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-oj.5.1.4 (note #3, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-oj.5.1 land agent. Not caused by the group-rail epic.

One run of `scripts/obsidian-record-walk-e2e.cjs` failed before any case ran, with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'openFile')` in `openNote` (obsidian-record-walk-e2e.cjs:61, via walker-footer `CdpClient.evaluate`). No active leaf existed yet when the first `openFile` ran. The same tree passed on rerun; 3 of 4 runs passed.

Fix: wait for layout-ready and a markdown leaf (or create one with `workspace.getLeaf(true)`) before the first `openFile`.

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 failure in 4 runs on the same group-rail tree (startup TypeError: null.openFile at obsidian-record-walk-e2e.cjs:61); the other 3 runs passed every case.

issue.creation_reason: The group-rail rail-proof phase saw the real-Obsidian record-walk e2e crash before its first case because no active leaf existed yet.
